title: "Cannot be set because it was not declared": ros2 param set and ParameterNotDeclaredException in ROS 2, measured
excerpt: ros2 param set and get_parameter errors for undeclared, wrong-type and read-only parameters in rclpy and rclcpp, why undeclared YAML, -p and launch values are dropped silently, and what allow_undeclared_parameters and automatically_declare_parameters_from_overrides change. Humble, Jazzy, Lyrical.
